allow: PowerShell($ram = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem\).TotalPhysicalMemory / 1GB; Write-Output \("Host RAM: {0:N1} GB" -f $ram\); $cfg = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.wslconfig"; if \(Test-Path $cfg\) { Write-Output "=== existing .wslconfig ==="; Get-Content $cfg } else { Write-Output "no .wslconfig \(WSL using defaults\)" })
Bash(wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -e bash -lc 'sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && echo "SUDO: PASSWORDLESS" || echo "SUDO: NEEDS_PASSWORD"')
Bash(wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -u root -e bash -lc 'id; echo "---"; echo "root shell OK"')

PowerShell($bat = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery\).BatteryStatus; Write-Output "전원: $\(if\($bat -eq 2\){'AC\(충전중/연결\)'}else{'배터리 or 상태='+$bat}\)"; Write-Output "=== 현재 AC sleep 타임아웃 ==="; powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP STANDBYIDLE 2>$null | Select-String "Current AC" ; Write-Output "=== 슬립 방지 설정 \(AC standby/hibernate = 0\) ==="; powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac 0; powercfg /change hibernate-timeout-ac 0; Write-Output "적용 완료 \(AC에서 자동 슬립/최대절전 끔\). 복구: powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac 30")

Bash(cd "c:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/MaruxOS/config-arm64" && stat -c '%n %s' firmware/start4.elf firmware/start4x.elf firmware/fixup4.dat firmware/fixup4x.dat firmware/overlays/*.dtbo isolation-test/kernel8.img isolation-test/bcm2711-rpi-4-b.dtb 2>/dev/null)
